The added spec (`spec/models/topic_embed_spec.rb`) covers only the basic relative-path conversion for default-port HTTP and does not pin behavior for non-standard ports or explicitly assert that already-absolute URLs are not modified. This is a specific, diff-grounded test gap, not a confirmed defect.
